title: quercus magnoliifolia var. macrophylla
intro: Quercus magnoliifolia var. macrophylla, commonly known as the large-leaved Chinese cork tree or large-leaved Chinese evergreen oak, is a variant of the Quercus magnoliifolia plant, belonging to the family Fagaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various ailments, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Quercus magnoliifolia var. macrophylla include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
